challenges.text: Do 15 star jumps
Run to the front door and back 3 times
Hold a plank for 30 seconds
Do 10 squats while singing Happy Birthday
Hop on one foot 20 times
Find something red and put it on the kitchen bench
Give everyone in the house a high five
Make your bed - properly!
Put 10 things away where they belong
Do a 30 second dance party (music optional)
Touch your toes 10 times, then reach for the ceiling 10 times
Crab walk from the fridge to the couch and back
Bring a pair of socks to the fridge
Do 5 push-ups (knees allowed!)
Balance a book on your head and walk around the kitchen
Get someone else to do 5 jumping jacks with you
Fill a glass of water and drink it
Wipe down the kitchen bench
Do 20 bicycle kicks lying on the floor
Run up and down the stairs twice
Do 20 burpees
Take the rubbish bin out
Tell a joke that makes someone laugh
Wall sit for 45 seconds
Walk like a penguin around the whole house

punishments: Everyone does a 5 minute tidy-up blitz of the lounge room
Everyone does 20 star jumps - together, right now!
Everyone folds a basket of washing
Everyone picks up 10 things off the floor
Family walk around the block after dinner
Everyone wipes a surface in the kitchen
Everyone does a 2 minute plank challenge (breaks allowed)
No screens for 30 minutes - board game instead
Everyone helps set and clear the dinner table
Everyone does a 10 minute garden / yard tidy
Everyone sorts the shoes at the front door
